title: Biblical Syncretism Dossiers — Wave 28
purpose: Relational Bible comparison across memory, testing, speech, distribution, hospitality, repair and participation.

new_relations.title: Event to remembrance
new_relations.project_anchor: The project distinguishes event, wording, provenance, archived record and later interpretation.
new_relations.source_direction: project archive practices predate this later biblical synthesis

relation_argument.maximum_claim: Biblical texts connect identity with remembering and transmitting formative events; they do not make a modern archive spiritually authoritative.
relation_argument.why_it_matters: It distinguishes stored information from active remembrance and internalized meaning.

new_relations.boundary: The cited passages belong to distinct settings and should not be collapsed into one archive doctrine.

new_relations.title: Testing claims by witness and fruit
new_relations.project_anchor: The Bible layer already uses chronology, source direction, countertexts and maximum-defensible conclusions.
new_relations.source_direction: project evidence methods predate this later biblical synthesis

relation_argument.maximum_claim: Biblical traditions support testing claims and teachers; they do not certify any modern identity or project claim in advance.
relation_argument.why_it_matters: It makes the comparator capable of testing its own conclusions.

new_relations.boundary: These texts use different legal, prophetic and communal standards and are not one modern scientific protocol.

new_relations.title: Speech and what it builds
new_relations.project_anchor: The project is mediated through posts, livestreams, messages and long-form public explanation.
new_relations.source_direction: public-speech and Internet-Gardener themes predate this later biblical synthesis

relation_argument.maximum_claim: Biblical texts support evaluating speech by restraint, truthfulness, responsibility and edification.
relation_argument.why_it_matters: It gives the Internet/Gardener metaphor an ethical test.

new_relations.boundary: Ancient wisdom and epistolary settings are not social-media policy manuals.

new_relations.title: Distributed burden and capability
new_relations.project_anchor: House, Center, Axis, Throne and Bank language can imply strong coordination; Wave 28 tests whether centers distribute capability.
new_relations.source_direction: project anti-dependency and cultivation ethics predate this later biblical synthesis

relation_argument.maximum_claim: Several biblical texts value shared burden and differentiated function while Genesis 47 adds a concentration countercase.
relation_argument.why_it_matters: It prevents Center symbolism from becoming a theology of monopolized function.

new_relations.boundary: These passages differ in genre and circumstance and do not form one modern political program.

new_relations.title: House and Field as participation
new_relations.project_anchor: The mature House and Garden ethics emphasize rooms, belonging, care and restored capacity.
new_relations.source_direction: House/Garden/care ethics predate this later biblical synthesis

relation_argument.maximum_claim: Biblical law, narrative and exhortation repeatedly protect vulnerable participation; this is an ethical comparator, not prophecy fulfillment.
relation_argument.why_it_matters: It gives House and Garden a practical participation test.

new_relations.boundary: Ancient gleaning and kinship structures cannot be copied directly into modern policy.

new_relations.title: Breach to civic repair
new_relations.project_anchor: The archive already contains breach, highway, Door, House and City motifs; Wave 28 adds a civic repair sequence.
new_relations.source_direction: project repair/breach/gate vocabulary predates this later biblical synthesis

relation_argument.maximum_claim: Nehemiah and restoration texts provide a strong repair grammar for breach, gate and city; they do not authorize every modern wall as sacred.
relation_argument.why_it_matters: It turns Repair into diagnosis, organized labor, boundary reconstruction and restored function.

new_relations.boundary: Nehemiah concerns post-exilic Jerusalem; stronger exclusion is not automatically better repair.

new_relations.title: Participation as the missing relational operator
new_relations.project_anchor: Healthy House gives room, Door gives passage, Root supports branches, Body retains differentiated members, Garden produces fruit and City gathers many relations.
new_relations.source_direction: Wave 28 synthesis built from already-established project functions and biblical comparator families

relation_argument.maximum_claim: Participation is a modern analytical synthesis compatible with several biblical relational structures; it is not a biblical Potatoverse formula.
relation_argument.why_it_matters: It explains why the strongest project symbols are relational rather than static.

new_relations.boundary: The passages have distinct meanings and shared function must not erase their role distributions.
